name: Agora_Market
description: A bustling open-air marketplace in an ancient Greek town with shaded colonnades and cheerful vendor stalls.

color_palette: Terracotta #D36C4E for roof tiles, amphorae, and clay lamps.
White Marble #F2F2F2 for columns, statues, and stoa walls.
Olive Green #6B8E23 for olive leaves, wreaths, and stall accents.
Aegean Blue #2E86AB for fabric awnings and water vessels.
Sandstone Beige #D8C3A5 for sun-baked paving stones and dust.
visual_style.architectural_style: Classical Greek stoa and colonnades with simple Doric columns, whitewashed stone, and red-tiled roofs framing an open square. Stalls are light wooden frames with colorful linen awnings and hanging amphorae. Signage uses painted symbols rather than words to suit young learners.
visual_style.flora_fauna: Potted olive and fig trees provide shade, with laurel shrubs near statues. Sparrows flit between stalls, and friendly stray cats lounge by fishmongers.
materials: White limestone and marble blocks for colonnades, steps, and paving.
Sun-bleached wood and rope for market stalls, awnings, and signs.
Terracotta tiles and pottery for roofs, jars, and lamps; bronze fittings for scales and handles.
